title: Ezra typed steps
description: A centred 64px light serif heading whose italic ending types itself out, pauses, deletes and types the next phrase, with a thin blinking cursor; under it three numbered steps (tiny 01/02/03, a 128px line icon, a 34px serif title, a body line) in columns, stacked on phones.
notes: the typing needs JavaScript; static HTML shows the first phrase whole, and reduced motion keeps it that way
the step icons are media slots (128px squares)
